Overview.Name: Sandhya Balusu
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Managing diabetes, thyroid, PCOS and hypertension, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction, Improving energy levels and body composition
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_2: Option 1: Curd (200 g) + cucumber salad + paneer cubes (120 g)
Option 2: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Cooked rice (150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Maintain fixed meal timings daily to support diabetes, thyroid and PCOS management.
Reduce sweets, bakery foods, sugary drinks and processed snacks.
Limit excess salt, pickles and packaged foods to support blood pressure control.
Start meals with protein (chicken, fish, eggs or paneer) before eating rice.
Get 20–30 minutes of morning sunlight exposure daily.
Regular yoga and a short walk after meals can improve blood sugar control and overall health.
Manage stress-related cravings with hydration, walking or relaxation techniques before eating.
